shared_elements: animal shown with head in profile
frontal-symmetrical arrangement about a central axis
horizontal band of repeated geometric pattern (zigzag/chevron)
raised arms/limbs flanking a central head
small repeated figures in a row
justification: Both surfaces depict raptor-headed/beaked creatures with outstretched limbs or wings and include a horizontal band of repeated zigzag or chevron ornament, plus a degree of axial symmetry. But A is a single elaborate frontal anthropomorphic bird-being with costume, jewellery and feathered wings, while B is a stacked multi-register composition of separate animals (quadruped in profile, small squatting figures, a long-necked bird, a snake-like form) with no unified figure, so the correspondences are of the generic kind any tradition could reach independently.
